notes: Fixed the table columns shown shifted one place right (v4.4-v4.6 screen bug; Excel/PDF exports were always correct), frozen the header row so it stays visible while scrolling, and made long flag notes fully visible. Reading is better: upgraded to the PP-OCRv6 engine, added a rescue pass that fills missing Net/T+W from a second OCR variant, and stripped bill-number fragments and column-header words from item names. Read now shows a loading bar and disables the button until done. New: Sell calculator (pick an item, enter grams, get SP with metal + customer making + 3% GST), Save Sale (saved per login, shown forever via the separate Saved Sales button in the top bar, duplicates refused).
